propositions: Residual live prose using deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' terminology.

A new repository guard (check_criteria_vocabulary.py) with a count-pinned plain-text allowlist must enforce suppression of 'Success Criteria' vocabulary reintroduction across the codebase, failing on count drift in either direction and malformed allowlist entries.

The guard must differentiate between full phrase matching (case-insensitive, repository-wide except archived/vendor/cache dirs) and scoped bare-token matching (SC/SCs only in reviewers, guides, criteria routing, and generated docs), with designated permanent carve-outs for T2 experiment, definition-of-done, migration artifacts, test probes, and frozen Jira fixtures.
The guard must be wired into the root Makefile lint target so that both local development and CI execute the same vocabulary check deterministically.

Four specific files (O-RAN-SC references in ADRs and gerrit workflow, minified editor.js) must remain byte-identical to commit a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c and pass the guard without rewriting.

After regenerating docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md via the registry command, the guard must pass with all deliberate vocabulary matches accounted for at their pinned counts and no unallowlisted instances.
